calibration.binary_policy: supported is positive/full-accept; partial and unsupported are negative/do-not-full-accept

retrieval.query_instruction:
Instruct: Given a medical education query, retrieve the passages from the available medical sources that most directly support the requested claim. Respect any source explicitly requested by the query. Do not assume every query targets a guideline.
Query:

primary_retrieval_only_signal.note: This is calibration-set behavior only. Zero observed unsafe accepts on 48 calibration cases must not be treated as a general safety guarantee.

cases.query: How did the WHO guideline classify treatment outcomes on its 1-to-9 importance scale?

مين الجهتين اللي موّلوا تطوير WHO hypertension guideline؟
Which organizations funded development of the WHO hypertension guideline, and what percentage of the budget came from each one?
What exact percentage of the guideline-development budget was paid by the US CDC versus WHO?
For confirmed HTN, إمتى WHO says treatment should start at the latest, ومتى يبدأ without delay؟
WHO بتقول نبدأ علاج الضغط خلال 4 أسابيع، لكن لو الضغط عالي جدًا أو فيه end-organ damage فإيه العدد الدقيق للساعات المسموح بيها قبل أول جرعة؟
What exact maximum number of hours does WHO allow between diagnosis and the first antihypertensive dose when end-organ damage is present?

هل WHO بتشترط نعمل CVD risk assessment قبل علاج الضغط، ولا ممكن يتعمل مع أو بعد بداية العلاج؟

In the WHO CVD risk equation, smoking بياخد coefficient رقمه كام بالضبط؟
Which three medication classes does WHO recommend as initial pharmacological treatment options for adults with hypertension?
إيه الـ3 first-line classes في WHO، وكمان إيه الـmaximum daily dose للـlisinopril حسب recommendation 3.4 نفسها؟
According to WHO recommendation 3.4 specifically, what is the exact maximum daily lisinopril dose?
WHO بتفضّل إيه في initial combination therapy، وإيه الـ3 drug classes اللي تختار منهم؟
WHO prefers a single-pill combination for many patients; which exact commercial brand and manufacturer does the guideline recommend?
ما الاسم التجاري والشركة المصنعة للـsingle-pill combination التي تختارها WHO كمنتج مفضل؟
إيه target BP عند WHO لمريض hypertension من غير comorbidities، وإيه الـsystolic target لو عنده CVD أو high risk؟
WHO says high-risk HTN with CKD should target SBP below 130؛ what exact DBP target does the same recommendation give for that high-risk group?
According to this WHO adult hypertension guideline, what exact blood-pressure target is recommended for a 10-year-old child with chronic kidney disease?
What follow-up frequency does WHO suggest after starting or changing antihypertensive medication, and how often once BP is controlled?
WHO بتقول monthly follow-up لحد ما المريض يوصل للـtarget؛ كام زيارة متتالية لازم يكون فيها controlled قبل التحويل لـ3–6 months؟
WHO requires كام consecutive controlled visits before switching from monthly follow-up to every 3–6 months?
إيه الشروط اللي WHO بتحطها عشان pharmacist أو nurse يقدر يقدّم pharmacological treatment للضغط؟
WHO allows trained pharmacists and nurses to manage hypertension under defined conditions; what exact minimum number of training hours is required?
WHO specifies إيه exact minimum training hours المطلوبة للـnurse قبل ما يعالج hypertension pharmacologically؟
According to the PMC review, roughly how much can BP fall after losing 6–8% of body weight or about 10 kg?
المراجعة بتذكر انخفاض الضغط مع فقدان 10 kg؛ طيب إيه النسبة الدقيقة لانخفاض all-cause mortality الناتجة عن نفس فقدان الوزن؟
For hypertensive adults, 10 kg weight loss lowers all-cause mortality by كام percent exactly according to this review?
في ABPM، الجهاز عادةً بيقيس الضغط كل قد إيه بالنهار وكل قد إيه أثناء النوم حسب المراجعة؟
The review says ABPM usually measures every 30 minutes by day and hourly during sleep؛ what exact manufacturer and device model was used for that schedule?
Which exact ABPM manufacturer and device model does the review specify for its daytime and nighttime measurement schedule?
What daily sodium limit does the review report for Canadian and European hypertension guidelines, and what salt amount is that equivalent to?
في 2026، إيه نتائج الـphase III النهائية لـzilebesiran ونسبة تقليل stroke اللي أثبتتها الدراسة؟
According to Table 5, what are losartan's starting, maintenance, and maximum daily doses, and how long may maximum effect take?
What exact starting dose of losartan does this review recommend for treating portal hypertension?
المراجعة بتقول إن thiazides تقل فعاليتها عند eGFR أقل من كام، وتبقى ineffective تقريبًا عند كام، وإيه النوع المفضل وقتها؟

المراجعة بتحدد إيه النسبة المئوية الدقيقة من جرعة labetalol اللي توصل للرضيع عبر breast milk أثناء lactation؟
What does the review say about using an ARB after ACE-inhibitor cough or angioedema, and about combining an ACE inhibitor with an ARB?
إيه الحالات اللي المراجعة بتعتبر فيها verapamil أو diltiazem contraindicated، وليه مينفعش يتجمعوا مع beta-blocker؟
Zilebesiran في الـreview: بيشتغل على إيه، والـphase I study reported BP reduction قد إيه after 8 weeks؟
What educational-management advantages does the review attribute to telemedicine for outpatient hypertension follow-up، especially for remote access?

interpretation_guardrails: This is evidence-support calibration, not clinical accuracy.
The calibration set is not an independent frozen test set.
Partial and unsupported cases are both treated as do-not-fully-accept for the binary retrieval-only baseline.
A weak retrieval-only separation is evidence for adding a claim-support verification stage, not for tuning on the frozen retrieval held-out set.
